title: Markus Monka
html: Markus Monka is the head of IT and VoIP infrastructure at sipgate, one of the major UC providers in Germany. He is managing the team that operates Kamailio as part of sipgate’s VoIP platform, interacting with out project since 2003. Markus has supported Kamailio project to organize many of its community events, such as 10 Years SER, Kamailio Development Workshops and Kamailio World Conference.
